evidence: Swap test fails: replacing the tool names with books, rooms or allotment plots leaves the frame intact (white bordered cards on a pale green-grey ground, one sans, a dark green filled button, top-right text nav); only the copy and the 'Open' session tags in the calendar are bound to this product (find/default/1280-light, tool/default/1280-light).

Category-guess test fails: the predicted default for a council/community booking flow (government-service-style form page, single sans, one muted green accent, bordered cards with a thumbnail slot, availability chip) is what renders; no identity-carrying element departs from it.
Similar-prompt test fails: 'reservation flow for a neighbourhood seed library' would plausibly land on the same masthead, same card grid with an icon tile, same calendar grid and session radio cards.

The only product-bound elements are content: volunteer-voiced copy ('Enough for a day of fixing shelves and a fence', 'We text you if a tool is returned late by the previous borrower'), deposit on every card, the calendar's 'Open' / green-dot session marking. There is no signature; the identity is the name 'Fernhill Tool Library' in bold body text beside a stock wrench glyph.

unfinished: Placeholder thumbnails on show: every one of the ten tool cards has the same pale-green square with the same wrench glyph instead of a picture of the tool (find/default all widths).
Identity is only the name set in bold body text next to a small stock wrench icon; no designed mark or typographic moment anywhere.

Browser-default controls in the filter panel: native date input showing 'yyyy/mm/dd' with the platform calendar glyph, native select 'All categories' whose label sits lower than its neighbour's (find/filters-open/1280-dark).
Headings differ from body only in size and weight; same face, same colour, no other voice (all pages).

Empty bands at wide widths: basket, done and confirm leave the right half and the bottom of the 1280 viewport bare pale ground under a footer that stops short (basket/default/1280-light, done/default/1280-light).

Basket session cards break their own row: one session full width, the other five squeezed into a five-column row with three-line wraps such as 'Saturday 24 / October, 10:00 to / 13:00' (basket/default/1280-light).

Sticky action bar slices through the calendar on the tool page, hiding the week of 11-17 October and cutting the 'Open' tag of Saturday 10 in half (tool/default/1280-light, tool/day-chosen/375-light).
No focal point on any page beyond the h1; the done page is a key-value table and a bordered paragraph.
evidence: find/default/1280-light: first viewport is h1, a grey paragraph, a full-width empty search field, then a 2x5 grid of identical cards; nothing rewards a look.
tool/default/1280-light: specification table, a select, a calendar of white boxes; clean but bare.
done/default/1280-light: 'Reservation confirmed' with a bordered table and a bordered paragraph, bottom 200 px empty.
Positive: colour is calm and consistent, copy is warm and concrete, dark theme is composed rather than inverted (find/filters-open/1280-dark) - orderly, but orderly is not appealing.
